caption:
For decades, India's best researchers left and rarely came back. In June 2026, the government put ₹200 crore on the table to reverse that.

The PM Research Chair Scheme aims to bring over 120 Indian-origin researchers abroad back into Indian institutions, with packages up to ₹14 crore each covering salary, lab setup and research funding. Total outlay: ₹200 crore, launched June 2026. The goal isn't just filling posts - it's pulling top-tier research talent back into Indian labs and universities.

Brain drain used to be one-directional. This is India putting a price on reversing it.

Sources: Ministry of Science and Technology, PIB (2026)
